The 15-minute window is 245 buyers against 91 sellers, with a sell/buy SOL ratio of 0.70 (37.88 vs 53.78). Early flow was also weak: sell_to_buy was 0.52 in the first two minutes after graduation, with a launch bot present. The +24.5% return over 15 minutes is a fresh high, and the drawdown from the 30-minute high is only 0.3%, so the coin hasn't yet shown a dip to absorb. With a 1.4-5.1% round-trip cost on a $20 ticket and a pool of 143.55 SOL, a sudden sell wall would likely take the exit price well below entry. Skip.
